claims.text: SGLang Model Gateway v0.3.1 added cache-aware radix-tree routing, PrefixHash load balancing, JWT/OIDC authentication, classification APIs, and reliability/observability changes.
The release notes report 10–12x cache-routing speedups and roughly 99% lower per-node memory use in project benchmarks; these are project claims.

limitations: Performance and memory figures are project-reported and hardware/workload dependent.
This gateway release is infrastructure support rather than a new model or agent capability by itself.
overrides.why_this_special: Useful serving/routing context for scalable agent workloads, but weaker as a standalone January narrative than core runtime releases.
overrides.rationale: Retain as bounded supporting/background evidence; do not allocate a standalone core story at the current page budget.

claims.text: SGLang v0.5.8 added day-zero GLM-4.7-Flash support, expanded diffusion serving, FlashAttention 4 decoding support, and multiple long-context / disaggregated-serving changes.
Release-note performance figures such as up to 1.5x diffusion speedups, near-linear chunked-pipeline scaling, and a 65% TTFT improvement for a GLM4-MoE setup are project-reported claims.

limitations: The release aggregates many upstream PRs and performance claims across different models/hardware.
Model support establishes implementation availability, not equivalent quality or production validation.
overrides.why_this_special: Shows January serving infrastructure broadening from LLM inference into diffusion and rapidly absorbing newly released model families.
overrides.rationale: Primary-source evidence supports Candidate Selection for a material January 2026 technical change.

claims.text: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Health as a dedicated health context with medical-record and wellness-app connections, separate health conversations/files/memory, and additional privacy/security controls.
At announcement time access began with a small early-user rollout / waitlist rather than broad general availability.

limitations: This is a domain-specific product surface, not evidence of a new base-model release.
Health-related usefulness and trust claims are product/vendor claims; clinical efficacy is outside this Special.
overrides.why_this_special: Demonstrates that agent/context architecture is becoming domain-scoped and permission-sensitive, but it is supporting evidence rather than a core systems story.
overrides.rationale: Retain as bounded supporting/background evidence; do not allocate a standalone core story at the current page budget.

claims.text: OpenAI released Prism on January 27 as a free cloud-based, LaTeX-native scientific writing and collaboration workspace with GPT-5.2 integrated into project context.
The product integrates AI with paper structure, equations, references, drafting, revision, and collaboration rather than operating as a detached chat surface.

limitations: The announcement is primarily a product/workflow release and provides less implementation detail than the agent-system engineering articles.
Claims about accelerating science are product positioning rather than independently measured outcomes.
overrides.why_this_special: A clear example of AI moving into persistent, project-aware workspaces; useful as context if page budget permits.
overrides.rationale: Retain as bounded supporting/background evidence; do not allocate a standalone core story at the current page budget.

claims.text: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio lists qwen3-max-2026-01-23 for international availability on January 27, describing merged thinking/non-thinking modes and built-in web search, web extraction, and code interpreter use during thinking.
The same lifecycle page records broad January 4 global availability for multiple Qwen3 and Wan 2.6 model families, including tool-oriented/coding and multimodal models.
Comparative capability language in the lifecycle catalog is vendor-reported and not independently reproduced.

limitations: Model Studio availability dates can differ by region and need to remain scoped to the listed deployment region.
The lifecycle page is living documentation; dated entries rather than current default aliases anchor January chronology.
overrides.why_this_special: Provides the model/API side of the January shift toward reasoning models that can directly invoke retrieval and code tools.
overrides.rationale: Primary-source evidence supports Candidate Selection for a material January 2026 technical change.

artifact.canonical_name: Claude Cowork research preview and new Claude constitution

claims.text: Anthropic’s January 13 Labs announcement states that Cowork launched as a research preview the previous day to bring Claude’s agentic capabilities to desktop workflows.
Anthropic published Claude’s new constitution on January 22 and states that the document is a crucial part of its model training process that directly shapes Claude behavior.

limitations: Cowork was a research preview, so announcement-time product boundaries must not be generalized to later availability.
The constitution describes intended behavior and training guidance; actual model outputs may not always follow its ideals, as Anthropic itself notes.
overrides.why_this_special: Pairs the expansion of desktop agent action surfaces with an explicit behavioral/training control layer, making autonomy and governance visible in the same month.
overrides.rationale: Primary-source evidence supports Candidate Selection for a material January 2026 technical change.
